pages.text: Right-click an alchemy recipe while wearing $(l)Sage's Gift$() to learn it; the recipe then turns into plain paper.$(br2)$(li)Recipes learned by $(l)epiphany$() also need Sage's Gift.$(li)Once every player in the world knows a recipe, it no longer appears in loot.$(li)The $(l)Book of Creation$() teaches all of them at once.

$(l)Where recipes come from$()$(li)Structure and vanilla loot chests, at most one per chest (three in the Spirit Realm)$(li)The wandering alchemist's trades$(li)Epiphanies$(li)Alchemical creations (affix accessory recipes)$(br2)Where to find each one is written on its own page.

$(l)Recipe Transcription$()$(br)Once learned, copy an $(l)unread$() alchemy recipe on a basic altar:$(li)the recipe (main material)$(li)paper, an ink sac, a feather$(li)2 alchemical essence$(br)Two copies come out.$(br2)Found in alchemy laboratory and cottage chests.

pages.title: Recipe Fragments
pages.text: With nothing but $(l)learned$() alchemy recipes on an altar, an empty-handed right-click breaks each into a $(l)fragment of its tier$() (basic and transmutation recipes only; the altar must be of at least that tier).$(br2)Seven fragments of one tier and a Transmutation Source (the main material) make a $(l)Mystery Recipe$() of that tier at an altar.

pages.title: Mystery Recipes
pages.text: Lay a Mystery Recipe in an $(l)enchanting table$() with a $(l)block of amethyst$() where the lapis goes: the three rows offer three alchemy recipes of its tier that $(l)you have not learned$(). Choose one; the amethyst block is spent and the mystery becomes that recipe.$(br2)As with enchanting, the offer follows your enchantment seed: closing and reopening the table deals no new hand, only a choice does. Boss-only and epiphany-only recipes never come of it; once you know every recipe of its tier, the table says so.
